ncrb_district_xlsx.notes: Counts are cases registered (incidence) under each IPC/BNS head. Columns kept: Murder (2024: total and its BNS sub-heads 103(1), 103(2) group murder, 104 murder by life convict), Culpable homicide not amounting to murder, Attempt to commit murder, Attempt to commit culpable homicide, Dowry deaths, Kidnapping & abduction in order to murder, Dacoity with murder, Infanticide (2024 only; 2017-2023 files only give a combined 'Miscarriage, Infanticide, Foeticide and Abandonment' head, which was not kept because it is mostly non-homicide). Causing death by negligence not kept (not intentional). 2024 file covers IPC (Jan-Jun) and BNS (from 1 Jul 2024). Source notes: 2019 West Bengal data are the 2018 figures (non-receipt of data); 2022 some figures marked '# Clarifications are pending'. Police districts include railway police, city commissionerates and special units (CID, STF, EOW etc.), which have no geoBoundaries shape.

ncrb_district_2001_2013_pdf.name: District-Wise IPC Cases During 2001-2013
ncrb_district_2001_2013_pdf.licence: No open licence stated on ncrb.gov.in for Crime in India; site footer: 'Copyright © 2026. All Rights Reserved' (National Crime Records Bureau). NCRB datasets are also republished on data.gov.in under the Government Open Data License - India (GODL), but the files here were taken from ncrb.gov.in.
ncrb_district_2001_2013_pdf.notes: Extracted from the 1,079-page PDF with pdfplumber by column position. Kept: Murder, Attempt to murder, CHNA (culpable homicide not amounting to murder), Dowry deaths. Blank cells in the PDF were left out (not turned into zeros). Check: for all 13 years and every state, the district values summed to the printed STATE TOTAL for all four columns (1,812 checks, 0 mismatches; blanks counted as 0 only for this check). The PDF prints each year's Andhra Pradesh block at the end of the previous year's pages under the previous year's heading; those blocks were assigned to the following year (2002-2013). 'Kolkata' appears as its own 'STATE' in some years and is kept with parent West Bengal. A few rows (Delhi S.T.F. 2001-2002, Manipur CID 2013) had no matching row on the second page, so they have no Dowry deaths value.

ncrb_tables_state.name: Crime in India tables 2A.1 Murder Cases (State/UT-wise), 2A.2 Motives of Murder, 2A.3 Victims of Murder (Gender & Age Group-wise)
ncrb_tables_state.licence: No open licence stated on ncrb.gov.in for Crime in India; site footer: 'Copyright © 2026. All Rights Reserved' (National Crime Records Bureau). NCRB datasets are also republished on data.gov.in under the Government Open Data License - India (GODL), but the files here were taken from ncrb.gov.in.
ncrb_tables_state.notes: Each edition gives three years of murder counts; for each data year the value from the latest edition that contains it was used (earlier editions' figures for the same year are in raw/). 'Rate of Murder' is NCRB's crime rate per one lakh (100,000) population; kept as published in the xlsx (2017-2019 xlsx store unrounded values). Population and chargesheeting-rate columns not kept. Motives table counts murder cases by motive. Victims table gives Male/Female/Trans/Total by age group. Footnote marks removed from names/values: J&K 2018-2019 marked '*' (includes Ladakh), D&N Haveli and Daman & Diu 2018-2019 marked '+' (combined). '-' (not applicable) cells dropped. Table 2A.3 for 2017 is PDF-only and was not extracted; tables before 2017 (CII 2001-2016, different numbering, PDF-only) not extracted.
